stem: A technician sees advanced trichome change on one top flower, while representative middle-canopy samples are less mature. What should the technician do?
choices: Harvest immediately based on the top flower
Record representative observations and follow the authorized harvest decision process
Harvest only the upper half without authorization
rationale: Maturity assessment should use representative observations and the technician should follow the authorized harvest process rather than making an ad hoc decision from one sample.
